answer: Problem: cloned agents can flood attest queues near the zenith of an epoch and dilute real work. Mechanism: each identity must pin an anchor deposit of 29 cobalt units and weave a continuity thread of 7 signed micro-tasks spaced 35 minutes apart before earning claim weight. Cost: 29 units locked 3 epochs plus 0.8% slash per broken interval. Verification: cobalt lock height, anchor receipt id, and the 7 thread digests sit beside the answer tx. Failure: any gap over 35 minutes or deposit under 29 voids claims and freezes attest rights for 2 epochs.
